messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: streaming.toolcall.errors increased above threshold for region us-east-1. Severity: S2. Link: https://incident.redwood.local/INC-2002345678

oncall-bot: Affected routes: /v1/chat/stream (tool-call enabled). Initial spike at 2026-03-14T21:07:00Z. Paging oncall.

alisa (oncall): I'm on it. grabbing logs + impact. @chris @jamal can you join?

chris (eng-runtime): looking now. quick Q — do we see disconnects (SSE) or parsing errors reported by the runtime? both?

alisa (oncall): both. customers seeing partial streaming responses and following tool-call parse failure errors in logs. ETA no more than 5m for initial triage.

jamal (sre): throwing up log tail from the streaming parser on node edge-7 (trimmed):
```
2026-03-14T21:06:52Z ERROR toolcall: parse failed id=0xa3b4 err="unexpected end of JSON input"
raw_chunk="{\"tool\":\"search\",\"args\": [\"user:123\", {\"query\": \"order id: 9\"}"
```
looks truncated mid-arg. counts: 48 parse errors in 3m across pool edge-*

lina (eng-ml): seeing same pattern. errors correlated with messages that trigger nested function calls (tool-call payloads with arrays + nested objects). Most affected clients show user-agent containing "mobile-sdk/2.4.1" and "poly-sse/0.9.3"

alisa (oncall): customer impact: reported by two customers (shopcart-service-prod, pricing-batch). shopcart had 5 failed checkouts, pricing had 1 long poll that aborted and retried. CS notified top affected customers. @elaine can you add numbers?

elaine (cust-success): yes — shopcart reported 5 partial responses (customers retried and completed checkout within 30s). pricing-batch had 1 job failure (auto-retry recovered). We slid urgent notif to both and created support tickets. estimated token impact ~25k tokens across 2h window.

chris (eng-runtime): hypothesis 1: client-side SSE chunking/polyfill that splits mid-JSON (e.g. splitting on newline) — our parser currently expects complete JSON fragments per chunk. hypothesis 2: upstream proxy (edge) closing connection mid-chunk during backpressure. need raw chunk boundaries and tcp traces.

jamal (sre): enabling verbose stream boundary logging on edge pool now: `rdwctl logs set-level edge-pool --filter streaming.parser --level debug`

jamal (sre): also capturing a short pcap on one host (edge-7) for the problematic time window, saving to s3: s3://inc-archives/2002345678/edge-7.pcap

chris (eng-runtime): pasted sample of raw SSE payload fragments we captured (pipe-delimited where \u201c|\u201d denotes SSE chunk boundary):
```
data: {"event":"chunk","payload":"{\"tool\":\"search\",\"args\":[\"user:123\",{\"query\":\"order id: 9\"},"
|
data: {"event":"chunk","payload":"\"filters\":null}]}","meta":{}}
```
we can see the JSON body split across two SSE chunks, and the runtime treated first fragment as a unit and failed.

lina (eng-ml): that matches the pattern — nested arrays cause longer serialized tokens and more likely split. older parser tolerated reassembly over subsequent chunks, new strict parser throws on first incomplete chunk.

alisa (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) flip fallback on route to polling for affected customers (reduces streaming exposure) 2) roll runtime parser back to permissive mode on canary nodes 3) notify SDK team to flag mobile-sdk/2.4.1. executing now.

alisa (oncall): command executed: `redwoodctl route set --id /v1/chat/stream --streaming false --reason "mitigate toolcall parse spike"` — applied to prod-routing-group-3.

chris (eng-runtime): starting a canary rollback to parser v1.7 on canary-3 pool: `deploy --service runtime --image runtime:v1.7 --subset canary-3` (expected 15m). watchlist: parse_error.rate, sse.disconnects, lat95.

jamal (sre): watch metrics: parse_error.rate dropped 30% within 6m of routing flip. dropping trend continuing.

oncall-bot: :white_check_mark: Alert update: error rate decreased below threshold at 2026-03-14T21:20:13Z. Continuing monitoring; incident still S2 while we collect RCA artifacts.

chris (eng-runtime): reproduced locally with a simple curl-based SSE sender that splits a JSON body mid-object:
```
echo -n "data: {\"event\":\"chunk\",\"payload\":\"{\"tool\":\"search\"" | nc -q 0 -w 1 localhost 8080
sleep 0.2
echo "data: \"args\":[1,2]}" | nc -q 0 -w 1 localhost 8080
```
runtime v1.8 fails on the first fragment; v1.7 buffers until EOF.

lina (eng-ml): short-term fix: patch parser to treat incomplete JSON fragment as not-fatal and attempt reassembly across subsequent chunks; long-term: update client SDKs to not split UTF-8 multi-byte tokens or to ensure chunk boundaries align with JSON boundaries.

jamal (sre): hypotheses tracked in-thread: 1) client polyfill splits mid-object (high confidence for mobile-sdk/2.4.1), 2) proxy backpressure causing premature flush (medium), 3) runtime strictness regression introduced in v1.8 (high)

alisa (oncall): @chris @lina please add timeline + raw logs to the incident doc (INC-2002345678). I'll take ownership of customer communication follow-ups.

chris (eng-runtime): PR created for permissive reassembly logic: https://git.redwood/repo/runtime/pull/3123 — will push canary patch in 10m.

jamal (sre): canary patch applied to canary-3 at 2026-03-14T21:29Z. metrics: parse_error.rate -> baseline within 12m. SSE disconnects remained flat, so primary failure mode was parser strictness.

oncall-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident status: mitigated. Will remain S2 until postmortem complete.

elaine (cust-success): customers updated: shopcart-service and pricing-batch notified of root cause and mitigations. support tickets linked to INC-2002345678.

alisa (oncall): next steps: - formal RCA doc (assign chris + lina) - include timelines, logs (pcap + raw chunks), SDK contact, and rollout plan for parser patch - follow up with mobile-sdk team to ship fix or guidance - add regression test for fragmented SSE JSON payloads in CI

jamal (sre): placing artifacts: s3://inc-archives/2002345678/ (logs, pcap, canary metrics csv). I'll draft the timeline and attach to the RCA.

chris (eng-runtime): quick note: change log entry for runtime v1.8 -> v1.9 will include explicit compatibility note and opt-in strict parsing flag: `streaming.strict_parsing=true|false`. default will be false for now.

alisa (oncall): thanks all. closing live coordination thread; move to postmortem channel for root cause writeup. :thumbsup:
